title: 1928 Declaration of Intention – Adam Kramer
description: United States Declaration of Intention filed by Adam Kramer on April 19, 1928, in the United States District Court for the District of Maryland. Adam identified himself as a 24-year-old seaman, born December 8, 1903, in Schweinfurt, Germany, and residing at 937 S. Kenwood Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland. He reported emigrating from Bremerhaven, Germany, aboard a vessel appearing to be named Derfflinger and arriving at New York on or about September 29, 1926. He identified his last foreign residence as Laufach, Germany, and stated that he was unmarried. The declaration records his intention to become a United States citizen.

title: 1931 Petition for Citizenship – Adam Kramer
description: United States Petition for Citizenship No. 12778 filed by Adam Kramer on November 27, 1931, in the United States District Court at Baltimore, Maryland. Adam identified his residence as 104 South Curley Street, Baltimore, and his occupation as mechanical engineer. He reported being born on December 8, 1903, in Schweinfurt, Germany, and marrying Sue Kramer on July 27, 1929, in Ellicott City, Maryland. The petition records Sue's birthplace as Deal Island, Maryland, and states that she resided with him. Adam reported Laufach, Germany, as his last foreign residence and his arrival in New York on September 29, 1926, aboard the Derfflinger. He reported having no children at the time. The witnesses were Matilda Wiethger and Mrs. Sue Kramer. The petition was part of the naturalization proceedings that resulted in Adam becoming a United States citizen on May 19, 1932.
